defect.description: The H2B runner was derived from the H2A runner, which in turn inherited the Phase-13 basename constants TRAINING_START_BASENAME / TRAINING_COMPLETION_BASENAME. These names do not include the experiment id, so each successive run in the lineage overwrites the same two audit files.
defect.observed: After the H2B run started, phase13_clean_v3_localizer_training_start.json contained H2B experiment content (experiment_id = post_phase13_h2b_...).
defect.pre_existing: YES — the H2A run used the same basename, so the Phase-13 content of this artifact had already been displaced before H2B. This is an inherited lineage defect, not introduced by the H2B scientific change.
defect.recoverable: NO — the file is untracked by git; no original copy is available.

containment.action: The two basename constants in the H2B runner were changed to experiment-specific names so H2B can never overwrite a Phase13- or H2A-named artifact again.
containment.mislabeled_phase13_named_file_deleted: NO — deliberately left in place rather than silently repaired, per project rule 'do not silently repair data; report rather than patch'.
containment.mislabeled_file_current_content: H2B experiment content (displaced Phase-13 content is unrecoverable)
containment.training_restarted_from_scratch: YES — the run was stopped at ~2 aborted epochs and relaunched clean with the corrected basenames (approximately 12 minutes of compute lost; no scientific state was produced by the aborted run).

rationale_for_not_check_required: The defect affects only the filename of a training-start reporting audit. No scientific measurement, checkpoint, history row, selection decision or downstream artifact is affected. It was detected, contained, and disclosed before any B1 result was produced.
recommendation_for_future_phases: Every runner derived from the Phase-13 lineage must rename TRAINING_START_BASENAME / TRAINING_COMPLETION_BASENAME to include its own experiment identity, or parameterise them from EXPERIMENT_ID.
